title: Applying and Releasing the Wayfare Rentals Security Deposit
content:
**Clause 1. Holding.** The class's security deposit is held at pickup of a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle.

**Clause 2. Application and release.** The deposit is applied or released only after the vehicle is returned: first to any unpaid charge, oldest first, each application clearing that charge by the same amount, and the rest released within the product's release period, 7 calendar days, of the return date.

**Clause 3. Evidence.** Whether the vehicle has been returned is read from the company's record of that rental: the rental must stand in returned or closed status. The deposit applied or released is the deposit of that same rental.

## Clause 2 restated

- *When.* Not while the rental is reserved, active or return due. Once it is returned or closed, the deposit may be applied and released.
- *Where it goes first.* To unpaid charges on the rental, the oldest charge first, then the next oldest, and so on.
- *Effect of each application.* Each amount of deposit applied to a charge clears that charge by the same amount, and the deposit is reduced by it.
- *What is left.* Whatever deposit remains after the unpaid charges is released, within 7 calendar days of the return date.

## Hypothetical settlements

**Settlement A.** A Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV, deposit $250.00, is returned with two unpaid charges: a mileage overage of $24.00 booked earlier and a late return fee of $70.00 booked later.

| Order | Charge | Deposit applied | Charge cleared by | Deposit left |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mileage overage, $24.00 (older) | $24.00 | $24.00 | $226.00 |
| 2 | Late return fee, $70.00 (newer) | $70.00 | $70.00 | $156.00 |
| Released | | | | $156.00, within 7 calendar days of the return date |

**Settlement B.** A Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan, deposit $250.00, is returned with an unpaid weekly charge of $239.00 booked earlier and an unpaid damage charge of $150.00 booked later. $239.00 of the deposit is applied to the weekly charge and clears it; the remaining $11.00 is applied to the damage charge and clears $11.00 of it. No deposit is left to release, and $139.00 remains owed on the damage charge.

**Settlement C.** A Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan, deposit $500.00, is returned with nothing unpaid. Nothing is applied, and the full $500.00 is released within 7 calendar days of the return date.

## Timing on the boundary

| Hypothetical rental status | May the deposit be applied or released now |
|---|---|
| Active, vehicle still out | No |
| Return due, vehicle not yet back | No |
| Returned | Yes |
| Closed | Yes |
